code_improvements.title: Add Search to PR List
code_improvements.description: Add search and filter functionality to the GitHub Pull Requests list, allowing users to quickly find PRs by title, author, or branch name.
code_improvements.rationale: The GitHub Issues list has comprehensive search/filter functionality (IssueListHeader with searchQuery, onSearchChange, filterState). The PRList component lacks this feature entirely despite handling similar list data. The useIssueFiltering hook pattern already exists and can be adapted for PRs.
code_improvements.implementation_approach: 1. Create usePRFiltering hook based on existing useIssueFiltering pattern. 2. Add PRListHeader component mirroring IssueListHeader structure with search input. 3. Wire up filtering to PRList component. The search should filter by PR title, author.login, and headRefName fields.

code_improvements.title: Consolidate Filtering Hooks into Generic useFiltering
code_improvements.description: Create a generic useFiltering hook that can be used across GitHub Issues, Linear Issues, PRs, and other list components, reducing code duplication.
code_improvements.rationale: Two nearly identical useIssueFiltering hooks exist - one in github-issues/hooks and one in linear-import/hooks. Both implement similar search/filter logic that could be abstracted into a shared generic hook.
code_improvements.implementation_approach: 1. Create generic useFiltering<T> hook in renderer/hooks/ that accepts items, searchQuery, and a searchFn predicate. 2. Refactor both useIssueFiltering hooks to use the new generic hook with domain-specific search predicates. 3. Export from hooks/index.ts for shared access.

code_improvements.title: Add Keyboard Shortcuts to Ideation Panel
code_improvements.description: Add keyboard shortcuts for common ideation actions: dismiss (D), convert to task (C), archive (A), select all (Ctrl+A), and refresh (R).
code_improvements.rationale: Keyboard shortcuts pattern exists in TaskEditDialog.tsx (Ctrl+Enter for submit) and App.tsx. The Ideation panel has frequent user actions (dismiss, convert, archive) that would benefit from keyboard acceleration. The store already has all the action methods.
existing_patterns: Keyboard shortcut registration pattern in App.tsx
code_improvements.implementation_approach: 1. Add useEffect with keydown listener in Ideation.tsx for global shortcuts (R to refresh). 2. Add onKeyDown to IdeaCard for item-level shortcuts when focused (D to dismiss, C to convert, A to archive). 3. Show shortcuts in tooltips using existing Tooltip component pattern.

code_improvements.title: Create Shared GenericEmptyState Component
code_improvements.description: Extract the EmptyState pattern from github-issues into a shared, reusable component that other features can use for consistent empty state UI.
code_improvements.rationale: EmptyState component in github-issues/components/EmptyStates.tsx is well-designed with props for icon, message, and searchQuery handling. IdeationEmptyState and RoadmapEmptyState implement similar patterns separately. A shared component would ensure consistency and reduce duplication.
existing_patterns: EmptyState component structure with icon, message props
code_improvements.implementation_approach: 1. Create GenericEmptyState in components/ui/empty-state.tsx with props: icon, title, description, searchQuery, actionButton. 2. Migrate github-issues EmptyState to use this shared component. 3. Refactor IdeationEmptyState and RoadmapEmptyState to use GenericEmptyState, passing domain-specific content.

code_improvements.title: Add Export to Markdown for Changelog Entries
code_improvements.description: Add ability to export changelog entries to a CHANGELOG.md file in the project root, formatted according to Keep a Changelog standard.
code_improvements.rationale: The changelog system has comprehensive formatter (formatter.ts), parser (parser.ts), and generator infrastructure but no export-to-file capability. The formatter already produces markdown-compatible output. This builds on existing changelog patterns to complete the workflow.
code_improvements.implementation_approach: 1. Create exporter.ts with exportToMarkdown(entries, projectPath) function using existing formatter. 2. Add exportChangelog IPC handler in changelog-handlers.ts. 3. Add export button to ChangelogHeader.tsx using existing Button component. 4. Write to {projectPath}/CHANGELOG.md with proper header and formatted entries.
